Host operations create/poll/message/checkpoint/cancel/resume/adopt idempotently with wall-clock bounded waits and honest usage.

Changed blobs, dependencies, authority, policy, environment, corruption, or cross-subject identity invalidate reuse.

Direct dependencies get compact bodies, transitive ones digest refs, unrelated context explicit omission, and cold retrieval evidence.

Calls record measured, estimated, or unavailable input/output/cache tokens; unavailable is not zero.
